title: Silence alarms with volume or power button press
symptom: User wants to silence/snooze xDrip+ alarms by pressing volume or power buttons, as when silencing an incoming phone call. They were caught in church with an alarm going off and had to use the snooze button on their Pebble.
cause: The developer found that intercepting volume buttons on the lock screen or screen off is unreliable, and that xDrip itself adjusts system volume based on alarm profile, causing self-triggering issues.
fix: The developer implemented silencing the alarm by pressing volume buttons from the app home graph screen, available in the latest nightly release. For locked or outside the app, no reliable method was found. An alternative suggestion is to use the ascending volume profile.
evidence_quote: What I have been able to make work is silencing the alarm by pressing the volume buttons from the app home graph screen.. This isn't ideal but it does make it that bit easier to manage at 3am etc.
